facts.fact: Kenya's Communications Authority opened its industry guidelines on child online protection for public input in 2021; the process stalled, and Watoto Watch Network with Amnesty International Kenya later convened two further consultations that fed into the final version published in October (year not stated), as reported by KICTANet.
